build_contract: The evaluator builds the target sources in /app/implementation with its trusted offline toolchain and executes that product directly. /app/run.sh and /app/build.sh are development entrypoints; replacing them does not replace the graded program. Put implementation sources and build inputs under /app/implementation.
interface: Run /app/run.sh as a JSON-lines service. Requests contain id, op="run", call="entry", and args (an array of positional arguments). Return one JSON object per request, preserving id: {"id": id, "ok": true, "value": result} or {"id": id, "ok": false, "error": message}. Do not write diagnostics to the response stream. The evaluator builds the target sources in /app/implementation with its trusted offline toolchain and executes that product directly. /app/run.sh and /app/build.sh are development entrypoints; replacing them does not replace the graded program. Put implementation sources and build inputs under /app/implementation. The first element of args selects the package operation; remaining elements are its positional arguments. Preserve all declared operations.
